fields.name: DatabaseBatch<TResult> Add family
fields.contract: DatabaseBatch<TResult> builds a Batch by accepting additions through one Add family. The family varies by input: an existing BatchStep<TResult>; a Query contract with no caller-supplied parameter collection; or a Query contract paired with a DbParameterCollection. Each variation appends one executable operation and returns the same DatabaseBatch<TResult> instance, so additions can be chained. Query-based additions execute without producing a TResult value.
